items.label: Deeper stacks
items.copy: Two more blocks for the robot's eye, so it can recognise shapes larger than a patch — and has that much more room to memorise the orchard it was shown.
items.notForSaleReason: No model has been trained for a deeper stack yet, so buying this would buy a run that cannot be scored.

items.label: Loss regularization
items.copy: The dial that pushes training towards simpler answers. Turn it off to watch a model obsess over one perfect fruit; turn it up until it stops noticing the worm.
items.notForSaleReason: No model has been trained at any other setting yet, so buying this would buy a run that cannot be scored.

items.label: Dropout layers
items.copy: Switches off a share of the pattern detectors at random during each training step, so no single one can carry the decision on its own.
items.notForSaleReason: No model has been trained with dropout yet, so buying this would buy a run that cannot be scored.
